narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as a multi-front conflict involving Iran, Israel, Ukraine, and the US intensifies, with kinetic exchanges, blockade threats, and diplomatic off-ramps failing to materialize. The market is underpricing the duration and structural impact of these conflicts, as evidenced by the EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline and the breakdown of equity support levels.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures and short S&P 500 index futures to capture the asymmetric risk premium from supply disruption and equity de-risking.

narratives.title: Energy Supply Chain Disruption
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy commodities as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026, with Kuwait seeking pipeline bypasses and the US releasing SPR barrels, which is actually a bullish signal of supply tightness. The market misreads these moves as bearish, but the structural damage to global oil logistics is driving a sustained premium.
narratives.trade_implication: Buy Brent crude oil calendar spreads for 2025-2026 delivery to profit from the prolonged supply deficit.

narratives.title: Risk-Off Rotation into Crypto
narratives.summary: Despite a BTC crash, capital is flowing into crypto as a macro hedge, with MicroStrategy buying the dip and whales holding, indicating that the selloff is macro-driven rather than crypto-specific. This divergence suggests institutional accumulation during risk-off episodes, positioning crypto as a store of value amid geopolitical uncertainty.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate Bitcoin spot ETFs on dips, targeting a 20% allocation of a diversified macro portfolio as a non-correlated hedge.
